hero.title: We bring clarity to enterprise data and intelligence
hero.subtitle: Most enterprises are data-rich and decision-poor — buried in dashboards, pilots and platforms that never quite pay off. Dataplexor changes that equation: we engineer the modern data foundations, production-grade AI and governed agentic systems that turn scattered information into decisions your business can act on and trust. One senior team, across products, services and consulting — from the strategy to the systems that run in production.

stats.label: Years of combined senior experience on the founding team
Data platforms and AI systems delivered across our careers
Industries our team has served, from banking to manufacturing
Senior practitioners on every engagement — no leverage pyramid

advantage.title: The Dataplexor advantage
advantage.intro: Dataplexor is built by people who have spent their careers designing data platforms, shipping production AI and leading transformations inside global consultancies and technology companies — and we do that work the way we always believed it should be done.

items.title: Decades deep, day one fresh
items.body: Every practice is led by someone with twenty-plus years in the field — and none of it is weighed down by legacy playbooks, old platform loyalties or a bench to keep busy.

items.title: Founder-led delivery
items.body: The people who scope your engagement are the people who deliver it. No handoff to a junior team after the sale — that is the model we left big consulting to escape.

items.title: AI-native from the start
items.body: We are not retrofitting an AI practice onto a BI-era firm. Our methods, accelerators and evaluation discipline were built for the agentic era from the first commit.

items.title: Evidence over tenure
items.body: We do not ask you to trust a brand. We ask you to judge working software, transparent methods and the track records of the individuals in the room.
